user.title: Add your first window
user.description: Adaptive Cover keeps every window in one house entry. Pick the cover of your first window and enter the direction the window faces; everything else has a default that you can change later. Add more windows with Add window on the Adaptive Cover integration page.

window.name: Window
window.description: The cover and the direction the window faces are enough. Every other value has a default.

window_setup_failed.title: {window} could not be set up
window_setup_failed.description: The window {window} failed to set up ({error}). The rest of the house keeps running, and the window tries again every minute. Check its cover and its settings (Change window).

consolidate_first.title: Consolidate the house on Adaptive Cover 2.0 first
consolidate_first.description:
Adaptive Cover 2.1 runs windows only inside the house entry, and {count} window entries are not in it yet: {windows}. Until they are, no shade moves.

1. In HACS, open Adaptive Cover, select Redownload and pick version 2.0.x. Restart Home Assistant.
2. Take a backup, then fix the "Move your windows into the house" repair (Settings > System > Repairs).
3. Update to 2.1 again and restart.

Adaptive Cover 2.1 changes nothing until then, so version 2.0.x finds every entry as it was.
